name: High Academic Defense Restyle
intent: Upgrade a thesis-defense deck from saturated template-blue to a refined academic system without changing slide wording, figures, or data.
rules: Do not replace imported figures, charts, microscopy photos, equations, or logos.
Prefer restrained contrast, generous white space, and recurring but non-identical academic accents.
Use gold as a scholarly highlight, cyan as a scientific/photonic accent, and navy only as a structural anchor.
